CL_max.source: 13 % symmetric section clmax ~1.15 at Re 3e5 x 0.9 for the wing; no polar identified (EX-09)

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)

conventions.aileron: per radian per surface, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: per radian, positive = trailing edge LEFT (dCn/dRud < 0)
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point

spanwise_progression.source: EX-14h: full spanwise stall progression from the calibrated induced map (strip loading relative to the wing mean), as D8b-R2d post-stall v2

positive.source: EX-14h, research/extra-300/ex14/fit_wing_polar.gd: the D8b-R2d post-stall v2 recipe (make_v2.gd) on this wing's calibrated attached line; post-peak knots [1.0, 0.86, 0.86, 0.82] of the strip peak at [18.0, 24.0, 30.0, 36.0] deg fitted with full spanwise progression to NASA FASER's measured whole-aircraft lift retention and stall-onset roll damping (Ultra Stick 120, Re ~3.6e5; Owens et al. AIAA 2006-3306 Fig. 2a, Hoe et al. AIAA 2012-4645 Fig. 14): RMS errors 0.059 retention, 0.255 Clp. Replaces the legacy blend's 14-18 deg roll instability (the violent stall wing drop; owners report a mild mushing stall). Analog RC airframe, not an Extra measurement; pre-peak knots and profile CD from the D8b-R2 fixture recipe, separated from 20 deg, Viterna beyond 36 deg

negative.source: EX-14h: the D8b-R2 fixture recipe's negative branch on this wing's attached line, retention 0.90; no measured negative branch

propulsion.description: O.S. MAX-61FX prototype engine (manual p3), using the existing NITRO MAX-61FX candidate profile and a dedicated Extra glow installation; APC 12x6 Sport nominal propeller uses borrowed UIUC APC 11x6 Ct/Cp measurements. The plan-derived shaft angles and visual propeller hub are applied; propeller normal force, P-factor and the quasi-static tail slipstream with swirl use the Glow propeller surrogate (EX-14c); exact prototype propeller remains unidentified. Fuel consumption is finite; Extra-specific carburetor-feed calibration is unavailable and omitted.

max_rpm_static.source: power balance: engine power assumed linear in rpm below the peak (estimated) = static prop power Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵ with Cp 0.0471 → n = sqrt(P_peak/n_peak / (Cp·ρ·D⁵))

lag_time_constant.source: first-order throttle response of a glow engine; replace with a throttle-step measurement

ct_table.source: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6: apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt (sha256 911866f1…) and apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt (sha256 987b1268…); applied to the 12x6 Sport by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ (APC's own 12x6 file is not reachable here); J = 0 row from the static run at 5,954 rpm, linear between J = 0 and 0.373 (no measurements there)

cp_table.source: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6: apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt (sha256 911866f1…) and apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt (sha256 987b1268…); applied to the 12x6 Sport by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ (APC's own 12x6 file is not reachable here)

rotating_inertia.source: Propeller + spinner + crankshaft about the shaft, for gyroscopic precession: APC Sport 12x6 about 37 g as a rod (m L^2 / 12 = 2.9e-4) plus spinner, nut and crankshaft (about 0.6e-4). Turns clockwise seen from behind (+x) (2-1/2 in spinner here, within the estimate)

thrust_line_offset.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: visual thrust_frame pivot/rotation and propeller child transform to actual hub; hub minus loaded inventory CG in [x_aft,y_right,z_up]

thrust_angles.source: Original plan thrust-frame notes transcribed in assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology); ordered [down, right] to match the v2 propulsion contract

normal_force.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: EX-14c: McCormick blade-element normal force per rad of disc angle of attack (Selig, AIAA 2010-7938), x rho n2 D4; Ct(J), solidity 0.0517, section slope and cd0 of the Glow propeller surrogate (app/data/glow/extra_61fx_2t.json)

pfactor_moment.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: EX-14c: McCormick P-factor yawing moment per rad of disc angle of attack (Selig, AIAA 2010-7938), x rho n2 D5; same Glow propeller surrogate

hub.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: EX-14c: propeller disc centre from the visual thrust frame (le frame), as thrust_line_offset

wash_factor.source: velocity added at the tail per disc induced velocity w (Selig, AIAA 2010-7938, eqs. 17-19, m = V/(V + w)): 0.8 at m = 0 and 1.8 at m >= 0.75 (Fig. 5); the P-51's value. No Extra wake measurement

swirl_factor.source: part of the propeller's angular momentum that reaches the tail (wing and fuselage straighten the rest): research synthesis 0.5-0.8, the P-51's value; Selig: the swirl offsets ~40 % of the torque roll

vertical_drift.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: 1 - d(eps)/d(alpha): the wake drifts with the downwashed flow

propeller_sidewash.source: Ribner, NACA ARR L4I12a (1944) eq. 8: far-wake crossflow of a propeller at incidence, applied as published (1); also selects the piecewise swirl quadrature (P51-26). The Glow installation supports only this quasi-static wake (EX-14c)

landing_gear.description: E5a: fixed main wheels and rudder-linked tail wheel. File-backed GP-02 wheel profiles supply per-contact radius, inertia and rim-speed dynamics; terrain-aware contact and wheel-radius corrections are active. E5a spring, damping, tyre and steering values remain provisional. The 1.25 breakaway factor is the shared E3b1 engineering estimate midpoint borrowed from Stik, not an Extra measurement; no caster or brakes.

position.source: assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology); wheel bottom = axle minus radius, transformed to LE frame. Axle stations/heights from EX-01 metrology; diameters from kit references; main track 0.32 m is estimated, not measured.

stiffness.source: E5a: numerical E1 heave rule omega*dt=0.09 at 240 Hz, total k=m*(0.09*240)^2; split by ground-projected static load share for equal sag. Not measured wire/strap stiffness.

damping.source: E5a: damping ratio 0.3 with loader m/3 convention, as the P-51 contact fixture; not a measured Extra leg/tyre response.

max_compression.source: GP-06c reserve-energy travel (main 0.10 m, tail 0.08 m): the peak compression of a level/three-point free drop at the former 14 CFR 23.727 reserve velocity, 1.2 x 7 ft/s = 2.56 m/s with wing lift 2/3 W through the CG (23.473(d)/(e)), x1.05 rounded up to 5 mm (research/ground-physics/gp06/reserve_drop.gd: main 93 mm, tail 73 mm). Replaces the E5a 0.08/0.05 m thresholds, which collapsed below the 7 ft/s limit drop. A full-size certification convention borrowed for RC; not measured gear travel or structural strength.
